svg.title: What every mode keeps, and what each mode removes
svg.desc: Every mode keeps a worktree that has uncommitted or untracked files, commits on no remote and not in the default branch, detached commits no branch holds, a process or localhost running inside, an agent session or a file change in the last day, is locked or protected, or is the main checkout. Then the modes differ. Idle removes nothing and reports. Proactive removes a worktree that is merged or whose remote branch is gone and that has been quiet for a week. Eager removes a worktree the review is sure is stale, and sends every other quiet one to a judge that keeps it only with evidence.
svg.text: Work stays. Then the mode decides.
Nothing below the first box is ever removed, whatever the model says.
uncommitted or untracked files · commits on no remote and not merged · detached commits no branch holds
a process or localhost inside · an agent session or a file change in the last day · locked · protected · main checkout
Merged, or the remote branch is
